Class PlayerRunStateItemAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.encounters.integration.PlayerRunStateItemAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItemRewardGateway
public final class PlayerRunStateItemAdapter extends Object implements ItemRewardGateway
Adapts Team 7's owned-item API to Chance transactions without running or reversing effects.

    • addItem

      public boolean addItem(String itemId)
      Description copied from interface: ItemRewardGateway
      Attempts to append one owned copy and retains rollback metadata before mutation.

      The caller must roll back the attempt even when this returns false or throws: a dependency may fail after changing ownership.

      Specified by:
      addItem in interface ItemRewardGateway
      Parameters:
      itemId - validated item ID
      Returns:
      true when exactly one copy was added
